Message:
As I was searching
for Lady Elfriede,
Illya and Miss Loki came
rushing towards me.

“Go to the Church ruins.
All manner of calamities
have converged there.

The only one who can
stop them is you,
Elfriede’s guardian knight.”
Illya held out a black key.

“If I go, I’ll end up
triggering a resonance
that’ll only make things worse.
So I can’t get close...
but you can...”

I then took the key
from Illya’s hand.

Lady Elfriede...
There are so many here
who care for you.

And yet...their voices will
fail to reach you, won’t they?

Because...you wish for death.
So that you can atone for
your sins with your life...
That much,
even I can understand.

I’ve been at your side
all this time, after all.

Still...even if honoring and
obeying your every wish
would be the right thing
to do as your knight, I...

I steel myself and
raise my head.

“I swear to bring
Lady Elfriede back.
No matter what it takes!”
